name: Ace of Pentacles
title: Ace of Coins
imagery: A single large coin fills the center of the card, richly patterned like a flower or a sun, with leafy stems curling from it above and below. It is solid, round and abundant.
meaning: The Ace of Coins is the seed of material good: money, health, home and the body. A new opportunity for security or prosperity is offered. Plant it carefully and it will grow.
numerology: The Ace is the seed of Earth, all its abundance in one coin.
affirmation: I welcome abundance and tend it well.

ctx.past: A practical opportunity in the past gave you a solid start.
ctx.present: A new chance for security, money or health is here. Take it.
ctx.future: A material opportunity or financial beginning is coming.
ctx.challenge: Greed or neglecting the practical side holds you back.
ctx.advice: Invest wisely in what will last. Care for your body and resources.
ctx.self: You feel grounded and ready to build.
ctx.others: Someone may offer practical help or a job.
ctx.hopes: You hope for security and fear scarcity.
ctx.love: A stable, grounded beginning in love.
ctx.work: A new job, investment or business seed.
ctx.spirit: Your guides remind you that the body and the earth are sacred.
ctx.shadow: Hidden here may be anxiety about money.
ctx.gift: Your gift is the ability to manifest.

name: Two of Pentacles
title: Two of Coins
imagery: Two coins sit at the top and bottom of the card, joined by a long ribbon that curls between them in an S shape. Card makers traditionally printed their name and date on this ribbon.
meaning: The Two of Coins is the flow of exchange: money moving, priorities juggled, adapting to change. Stay flexible and keep things in motion.
affirmation: I adapt with grace and balance.

ctx.past: You learned to juggle demands before.
ctx.present: You are balancing several things. Stay flexible.
ctx.advice: Prioritize and keep a playful attitude.
ctx.others: Others may make demands on your time.
ctx.love: Balancing love with other parts of life.
ctx.spirit: Your guides ask you to find rhythm.
ctx.release: Release the urge to do everything.

name: Three of Pentacles
title: Three of Coins
imagery: Two coins sit above and below a third, framed by leafy stems that weave around them.
meaning: The Three of Coins is skilled work and collaboration. Your efforts begin to bear fruit through craft and teamwork.
affirmation: I build with skill and care.

ctx.past: Past training or teamwork laid your foundation.
ctx.present: Your skills are growing through collaboration.
ctx.future: Recognition for your craft is coming.
ctx.advice: Work with others and refine your skill.
ctx.shadow: Hidden here may be doubt about your skill.

name: Four of Pentacles
title: Four of Coins
imagery: Four coins sit at the corners of the card with a fifth decorative emblem or flower at the center. The arrangement is square and solid.
meaning: The Four of Coins is material security. You hold on to what you have. Stability is good, but avoid holding too tight.

ctx.past: You built security in the past.
ctx.advice: Save wisely but do not hoard.
ctx.spirit: Your guides ask what you cling to.
ctx.shadow: Hidden here may be fear of scarcity.

name: Five of Pentacles
title: Five of Coins
imagery: Four coins sit at the corners with a fifth coin at the center, breaking the square of four.
meaning: The Five of Coins brings material challenge or insecurity. Change disrupts stability. Seek help and remember your inner resources.
affirmation: I find help and strength in hard times.

ctx.challenge: Feeling left out in the cold.
ctx.spirit: Your guides remind you of inner wealth.

name: Six of Pentacles
title: Six of Coins
imagery: Six coins are arranged in two columns of three, with flowering stems between them.
meaning: The Six of Coins brings generosity and fair exchange. Give and receive in balance.
affirmation: I give and receive with balance.

ctx.future: Help or a gift is coming.
ctx.shadow: Hidden here may be power imbalance.

name: Seven of Pentacles
title: Seven of Coins
imagery: Six coins form two columns with a seventh at the center, entwined by leafy stems.
meaning: The Seven of Coins asks for patience. Your investment is growing. Assess progress and wait for the harvest.
affirmation: I trust slow and steady growth.

name: Eight of Pentacles
title: Eight of Coins
imagery: Eight coins fill the card in two columns of four, with stems and flowers weaving between them.
meaning: The Eight of Coins is diligent work. Master your craft through steady practice.
affirmation: I master my craft through practice.

name: Nine of Pentacles
title: Nine of Coins
imagery: Eight coins form two columns with a ninth at the center, surrounded by flowers.
meaning: The Nine of Coins is comfort earned through effort. Enjoy your independence and abundance.
affirmation: I enjoy the abundance I have created.

name: Ten of Pentacles
title: Ten of Coins
imagery: Ten coins fill the card in two columns with flowers between them.
meaning: The Ten of Coins represents lasting wealth and legacy. Family and long-term security are favored.

ctx.past: Family or tradition shaped your security.
ctx.shadow: Hidden here may be inherited fears.
ctx.gift: Your gift is building something lasting.

name: Page of Pentacles
title: Valet of Coins
imagery: A young valet stands holding a coin raised before him, studying it closely. A second coin often lies on the ground at his feet.
meaning: The Valet of Coins is the eager student of the practical world. A new opportunity to learn or earn appears.

ctx.future: A new practical chance is coming.

name: Knight of Pentacles
title: Knight of Coins
imagery: A knight rides holding a staff, with a coin floating in the air before him. His horse moves at a measured pace.
meaning: The Knight of Coins is steady and reliable. He makes progress through patience and hard work.
numerology: The Knight carries the suit into action.

ctx.future: Slow but sure progress is coming.

name: Queen of Pentacles
title: Queen of Coins
imagery: A queen sits holding a coin and a scepter, calm and grounded.
meaning: The Queen of Coins is practical and nurturing. She creates comfort and abundance for those she loves.
numerology: The Queen holds the suit inwardly.

ctx.present: Care for yourself and others practically.
ctx.shadow: Hidden here may be neglected self-care.

name: King of Pentacles
title: King of Coins
imagery: A king sits holding a coin, his posture settled and prosperous.
meaning: The King of Coins is prosperous and generous. He has built lasting success and shares it wisely.
numerology: The King holds the suit outwardly with mastery.

ctx.others: A wealthy or established person helps.
ctx.shadow: Hidden here may be fear of loss.
